svg.aria-label: One frame: sync, tick, notify, paint
svg.title: One frame: sync, tick, notify, paint
svg.desc: A loop with four stations along the top. 01, world.sync(): changes from other people land. 02, world.tick(pipeline): your systems run over the columns. 03, reactive.notify(): observers fire, once. 04, paint(): you draw the finished state. The loop closes along the bottom through requestAnimationFrame.
